messages.content: Find the winning percentage of Lakers and Bulls in NBA seasons 2018 and 2020.

function.name: calculate_winning_percentage
function.description: Calculate the winning percentage for a particular basketball team in a given season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the basketball team.

season.description: The season (year) you want to find winning percentage for.

message.content:
**NBA Team Winning Percentages**

| Team                | Season (ended year) | Record (Wins – Losses) | Total Games Played | Winning Percentage |
|---------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------------------|-------------------|
| **Los Angeles Lakers**   | 2018 (2017‑18 season) | 52 – 30                 | 82                  | **63.4 %** |
|                     | 2020 (2019‑20 season) | 33 – 39                 | 72*                 | **45.8 %** |
| **Chicago Bulls**        | 2018 (2017‑18 season) | 41 – 41                 | 82                  | **50.0 %** |
|                     | 2020 (2019‑20 season) | 22 – 48                 | 70*                 | **31.4 %** |

\*The 2019‑20 season was shortened because of the COVID‑19 pandemic—teams played fewer than the usual 82 regular‑season games (Lakers: 72 games, Bulls: 70 games).

---

### How These Numbers Were Calculated  
Winning percentage \(P\) is computed as  

\[
P \;=\;\frac{\text{Number of Wins}}{\text{Total Games Played}}
\]

Rounded to one decimal place for readability:

| Team & Season | Formula | Result |
|---------------|---------|-------|
| Lakers 2018 | \(52 / 82 ≈ 0.634\) | **63.4 %** |
| Bulls 2018 | \(41 / 82 = 0.500\) | **50.0 %** |
| Lakers 2020 | \(33 / 72 ≈ 0.458\) | **45.8 %** |
| Bulls 2020 | \(22 / 70 ≈ 0.314\) | **31.4 %** |

These figures reflect how often each franchise secured victories during their respective seasons.
